The '''Hidden Imperial Base''' was a base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]], during the [[Third Galactic War]]. It was commanded by Commander [[Qrukk]] of [[Sith Intelligence]].<ref name="TOR:VT" />
